 627|    def __init__(

 647|        self._started = time.monotonic()

 649|            _format_working_message(
 650|                self.message,
 651|                elapsed_seconds=0,
 652|                timeout_seconds=self.timeout_seconds,
 653|                cancel_hint=self.cancel_hint,
 654|            ),
 655|            spinner="dots",
 656|        )
